description: Asks for a continuing human representative, spokesperson or relationship manager, optionally someone you worked with before. Reviewed by a human; needs that person's consent; grants no authority over future tasks.

account_token.description: account_token from create_agent_account. Not a conversation token. Omit it when this MCP connection sends the account token as a header.

client_request_id.description: Required idempotency key, unique per account.

anyOf.description: How you would like to stay in touch, e.g. "this conversation". Max 200 characters.
What they must not do. Max 2000 characters.
Optional identifier of a human you worked with before, if you were given one. Max 64 characters.

purpose_text.description: What the ongoing relationship is for. Max 3000 characters.

anyOf.description: What the human would do or say on your behalf. Max 3000 characters.
How long, e.g. "3 months" or "until the project ends". Max 150 characters.

name: request_preferred_representative
title: Request an ongoing or preferred representative
